subject.title: v2026.6.x system prompt bloat causes instruction following degradation on smaller models

question: What default policy should OpenClaw use so platform guidance, activated skills, bootstrap context, and user AGENTS.md instructions stay ordered correctly for smaller or weaker models?
rationale: The remaining work is not a single mechanical bug fix; it spans prompt precedence, skill loading, local-model defaults, optional tool exposure, and possible config/documentation changes.

options.title: Define a prompt-priority policy
options.body: Choose explicit ordering and model-aware scoping rules for skills, bootstrap, tools, and user instructions, then implement targeted defaults and tests for smaller models.

options.title: Fold into broader compaction work
options.body: Track this under the context-budget/compactor design so prompt slimming, skill selection, and memory/bootstrap compaction land as one coordinated feature.

options.title: Require stronger reproduction first
options.body: Keep only the current opt-in mitigations until a live small-model transcript shows a current-main failure that maintainers agree to support by default.

recommendation.title: Define a prompt-priority policy
recommendation.body: Choose explicit ordering and model-aware scoping rules for skills, bootstrap, tools, and user instructions, then implement targeted defaults and tests for smaller models.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses prompt, runtime, and product policy boundaries where Peter Steinberger has repeated history and likely routing context.
